items.summary: Approve containment-only execution. Reject unsupported financial, production, queue, requeue, telemetry, deployment, spending, monetization, and outreach work. Preserve aggregate commission as unattributed; keep private and parked gates unchanged. Owner concern: any permission request remains unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Continue existing delivery containment and failure-repair review. Before dispatch or requeue, require dated ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, release, deduplication, security, attribution, and measurement evidence.

Continue existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation only. Preserve provider aggregate earnings as unattributed; do not infer site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, cost-to-learn, forecasts, or causal lift.
Continue existing launch-readiness evidence work and keep the gated product private. Keep permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Preserve private launch gates; do not access credentials or private containers, alter permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct outreach.
